_comment: Copy to <pr-id>.json. Every goal needs >=1 existing vitest file; every path must exist; rollback must say how the PR is undone.
title: Human title

goals.text: One design goal, phrased as an observable outcome
covers: R-…  (programme.json requirement ids this PR is assigned)

_acceptedGatesComment: Optional. Only R3/R2, only for load-timeout failures in untouched files that pass alone (auto-verified). Shape: "acceptedGates": { "R3": { "reason": ">=40 chars", "isolationEvidence": "...", "approvedBy": "..." } }

launch._docsComment: Give exactly one of docs (files this PR updates) or docsNone (a >=20 char reason a schema-only/no-docs PR changed none).
launch.rollback: Revert the PR; additive schema columns stay and are unused.
